capabilities.why: Every command passes through SafetyHook before the guest sees it. It blocks non-allow-listed egress, secret/.env reads and destructive rm, and audits blocked attempts. A prompt-injected README is stopped by code, not by a polite system prompt.

When step 7 of 10 fails, the resume policy keeps the same guest and disk, restarts it via stop/start if it is unreachable, and retries only the failed step. Without persistent disk state the half-finished workspace would be lost and all six prior steps replayed.
